_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX fee-dialog 887:22019. Same tolerances as buttons/cards/dialog-master. The Close Circle 'X' icon is a Feather glyph (font glyph not vector) so iconDeviations waives the per-icon vector-path identity check (geometry/box still validated).
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* for Latin. These aliases keep the diff free of phantom font deviations.

deviations.reason: Centered single-digit '1' in 20-wide column (col1 阶梯/Tier). Figma's TEXT layout box reports x=18 w=20 (the cell slot), but impl's getBoundingClientRect reports the visible glyph (~5px wide) centered inside the slot → x=25.5 = 18+(20-5)/2. Same font-glyph-width artifact documented in account-states.tsx (PJS glyph widths tighter than HarmonyOS reference). Cell padding/row/column layout all match — purely a measurement-convention difference.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI / Close Circle$
iconDeviations.reason: Fee-dialog close icon — Feather 'x' glyph wrapping a 20×20 frame (same icon-font system as the dialog-master master). Geometry/box still validated; only vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Vector$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG vector child of the Feather close glyph; the outer 20×20 icon frame is already validated by token diff.

_iconDeviationsNote: Close-circle X uses Feather glyph consistent with app-wide icon system. The vector-path identity is waived but the icon frame's bg/size/color is still numerically checked.
